remarks: Welcome to 240 Lakefront Boulevard, an impeccably maintained, three-level townhouse nestled in Buffalo’s coveted Waterfront Village. The words to describe this home are comfortable elegance. The home is blended with timeless craftsmanship with modern sophistication. From the moment you enter, you’ll appreciate the refined details, including exquisite molding, soaring ceilings, integrated speakers, and recessed lighting throughout. The home offers three spacious bedrooms, three full bathrooms, and one-half bath. The first level features a gracious entryway with a coat closet, a private bedroom with an en suite bath, perfect for guests or a home office and convenient access to the attached two-car garage. Ascend to the second floor, where an impressive chef’s kitchen awaits. Designed for both style and functionality, it boasts a six-burner gas range with exterior venting hood, stainless steel appliances including a dishwasher and refrigerator, a wine cooler, stunning granite countertops, and abundant cabinetry. The lovely family room is warm and inviting, highlighted by a gas fireplace, expansive windows that flood the space with natural light, and direct access to a private patio ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The third level is dedicated to comfort and retreat. The luxurious primary suite features a large walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bath complete with dual vanities, an oversized marble shower, and a freestanding slipper tub. An additional generously sized bedroom with its own en suite bath and walk-in closet, along with a conveniently located washer and dryer, completes this floor. Wake each day to breathtaking views of the Buffalo skyline, Erie Basin Marina, and Lake Erie stretching all the way to Canada an extraordinary backdrop to everyday living.
